datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC classification scenarios were compiled for medium-term projections in Mozambique during 2022, with spatial boundaries and classification values recorded for January and February periods.
